results.text: Passwords must have at least fourteen characters and are changed only when compromised. Multi factor authentication is mandatory for every system that holds company data.
The office is open from seven to nineteen on working days. Visitors must be registered at the reception and wear a badge.
Travel expenses are reimbursed within thirty days with receipts attached. Flights must be booked in economy class for journeys shorter than six hours.
Employees accrue twenty-five days of paid annual leave per year. Leave requests must be approved by the line manager at least two weeks in advance.
Unused annual leave can be carried over to the next year up to five days. Carried over days expire on the thirty-first of March.
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week after agreement with the manager. Remote workers must be reachable during core hours.
New employees receive a laptop, badge and accounts on their first day. The buddy introduces the team and the tools during the first week.
Confidential information may not be shared outside the company without written approval. The obligation continues for five years after the end of employment.
